svg.title: DATUM Gateway: recommended Bitcoin mining setup
svg.desc: Your ASIC miners connect to DATUM Gateway using Stratum v1 on TCP port 23334. The Gateway gets block templates from your Bitcoin Core node and submits solved blocks through JSON-RPC on port 8332. Your node connects directly to Bitcoin peers on TCP port 8333. For optional pooled rewards, the Gateway connects to OCEAN mining pool running DATUM Prime over encrypted DATUM on TCP port 28915. Optional remote ASIC miners connect through their own router, the Internet or a VPN, and your site router to the same Gateway. Remote miners do not get all the benefits of a server connection on the same LAN. For maximum benefit, run DATUM Gateway and your Bitcoin node on the same LAN as your miners. Templates are created locally. Ports shown are defaults. The official upstream repository is https://github.com/OCEAN-xyz/datum_gateway; a QR code with the DATUM logo links to it.

Note: Remote miners do not get all the benefits of a server connection on the same LAN.
For maximum benefit, run DATUM Gateway and your Bitcoin node on the same LAN as your miners.
Bitcoin Core and DATUM Gateway can share a host. Keep RPC access restricted to your Gateway.
Your node creates the templates. The pool coordinates rewards.
Ports shown are defaults. Dashed links are optional. Non-pooled solo mining does not require a pool connection.
